Fourier transform

Transformation used in harmonic analysis
Related topic: Fourier series.

A Fourier transform represents a signal in terms of its frequency components. The choice of normalization changes the notation without changing the underlying idea.

Definition

edit

One common convention uses the following expression:

F(k)=∫f(x)e−2πikxdxF(k)=\int f(x)e^{-2\pi ikx}\,dx

The integration variable and the frequency variable describe different domains.

Computing

samples = read_signal()
spectrum = transform(samples)

Applications

Frequency descriptions are useful in signal processing, optics, and mathematical analysis.
